searchText: Dev updates week #9 | 11.9.-17.9. <@&857649635274915900> Weekly standup starting in <t:1694444400:R> https://meet.ethereum.org/epf-standup ah... monday was my least favourable day. I missed it this week too <@&857649635274915900> <@&1126618846711795912> Hey folks, anyone coming to Protocol Berg and wants to meet up? I will be in Berlin for 3 days, vote here which day would prefer and we can grab some EPF drinks or so 1️⃣ Sep 14, Thursday 2️⃣ Sep 15, Friday 3️⃣ Sep 16, Saturday Damb berlin sounds fun, hope everyone has a good time👍 these are the other events that are going on in Berlin during Protocol Berg https://blockchainweek.berlin/ i have a soft spot for raves (i'll likely get barred due to dress code, need to look slick in Berlin), but i also like early nights so i'm fresh for other events, hence my choice for 16th Here is the recording from today's standup https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Jc60yMf6XhP4OrJ_lluoDerl_v6qLFEL/view?usp=sharing As mentioned today, tomorrow will be the last office hours for project presentations. We have 10+ on the rosters, so we will be limiting the time for each presentation to 10 mins or less. If you are presenting tomorrow, please be succinct and efficient in your presentation. This office hours will also be 90 mins, going 30 mins after the hour. For those that do not get to present, please record a video of yourself giving the project presentation and post it here for the group to see. Hi everyone! I wrote an article talking about the architecture Flashbots uses for their PBS implementation. Maybe it can be useful to some of you 🙂 https://hackmd.io/@danielrachi/HJxXjUwC2 Going to give this a read > I think the reason you need an EL+CL combo running for MEV boost is that the CL client won’t start unless it has an EL client to connect to The reason is that a validator needs to actually validate blocks. If everyone were to use a portal client on that system then flashbots would run Ethereum Hi all! Haven't been able to make the meetings due to a conflict, so I've recorded my project proposal and posted it here. Feel free to offer any feedback and I'm happy to answer any questions! (cc'ing <@914307919699406908> as well) https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a9dGXZ8tuL1O43UZPYno9hKOBJRSst5S/view?usp=sharing Another round of project proposals starts tomarrow btw

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
> I think the reason you need an EL+CL combo running for MEV boost is that the CL client won’t start unless it has an EL client to connect to

The reason is that a validator needs to actually validate blocks. If everyone were to use a portal client on that system then flashbots would run Ethereum
